# Marketer Raja

> Marketer Raja is a performance-driven digital marketing and lead generation agency based in Sankari, Salem, Tamil Nadu, India. It helps local and global businesses grow through SEO, Google & Meta performance ads, landing page design, and WhatsApp lead automation — serving Salem, Sankagiri, Elampillai, Sankari, Tiruchengode, Namakkal, and clients across India and worldwide.

## Services

- [SEO Services](https://www.marketerraja.com/seo.html): Search engine optimisation to improve organic rankings and local search visibility.
- [Google Ads](https://www.marketerraja.com/google_ads.html): Google performance advertising campaigns for lead generation.
- [Meta Ads](https://www.marketerraja.com/meta_ads.html): Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns for lead generation.
- [Web & App Development](https://www.marketerraja.com/web.html): Website and landing page design and development.
